Description: @rosegriffon/ui/styles.css carries the M3 tokens the seven themes the shadcn bridge and the shared utilities; apps add only their own tokens
Do: Import tailwindcss then @rosegriffon/ui/styles.css at the top of globals.css
Don't: Copy theme blocks into each app

Description: Tailwind detection stops at the project root and ignores node_modules where @rosegriffon/ui is a symlink, so utilities used only by shared components are never generated
Do: Add @source for packages/rg-ui/src and packages/rg-app-shell/src
Don't: Assume workspace packages are scanned

Description: The build can run from the monorepo root, so rg-website pins its base and azalee-web uses source(none) with an explicit @source list
Do: Use source("../..") or source(none) plus @source
Don't: Depend on the build working directory

Description: rg-ui and rg-app-shell ship TypeScript source; Next must transpile them
Do: List @rosegriffon/ui and @rosegriffon/app-shell in transpilePackages
Don't: Prebuild the packages or import from dist

Description: Without optimizePackageImports an import from the barrel pulls all components into the importing module graph
Do: Add @rosegriffon/ui to experimental.optimizePackageImports
Don't: Import the barrel from hot paths without optimization
Code Bad: import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" // re-exports the whole barrel

Description: Consumers resolve the local owner through the root workspace
Do: Use "@rosegriffon/ui": "workspace:*"
Don't: Pin the published @aphrody/rg-ui copy inside the monorepo

Description: Themes are classes on html or an ancestor: theme-roy theme-gaelle theme-azalee-light theme-azalee-dark theme-achillea (bare roy gaelle aliases also match) plus generated theme-rg and theme-rg-dark
Do: Put one theme class on html
Don't: Use data-theme attributes or inline palettes

Description: An inline script first in head reads rg-theme from localStorage and sets the class before first paint; next-themes takes over after mount
Do: Keep the theme script first in head and suppressHydrationWarning on html
Don't: Let next-themes inject the class after paint

Description: The provider wraps next-themes with attribute class storageKey rg-theme defaultTheme roy enableSystem false and the five chrome themes
Do: Wrap the app with ThemeProvider from @rosegriffon/ui
Don't: Configure next-themes with a different theme list per app

Guideline: Theme sections with a container class
Description: Section identity (Azalée dark under /wiki, Achilléa under /achillea) goes on the content container so navigation never overwrites the saved preference
Do: Set theme-azalee-dark or theme-achillea on #main-content
Don't: Call setTheme when entering a section

Description: rg-ui paints every non-root theme container with :where(.theme-x:not(:root)) so text and background come from the same token set (a mismatch measured 1.19:1)
Do: Rely on the zero-specificity container painting
Don't: Leave a nested theme container transparent over another theme

Guideline: Keep app token defaults in @layer base
Description: Theme blocks live in @layer base; an unlayered :root in an app beats every layered theme rule and freezes the palette
Do: Wrap app :root defaults in @layer base
Don't: Declare app tokens on an unlayered :root

Description: brands.css is generated from crates/aphrody-m3-tokens (seeds #e91e63 #f89c5a #6d00ce) and is unlayered, so its Azalée and Achilléa roles override the hand-written styles.css blocks
Do: Regenerate with scripts/tools/rg-m3.ts
Don't: Hand-edit brands.css or fix a colour in the overridden styles.css block

Guideline: Extend dark: to the dark themes
Description: Shared components use dark: utilities; without the custom variant they stay inert under azalee-dark
Do: Declare @custom-variant dark with .dark .azalee-dark and .theme-azalee-dark
Don't: Leave dark: bound to .dark only

Description: Each theme block sets color-scheme light or dark so form controls and scrollbars match the palette
Do: Add color-scheme to any new theme block
Don't: Ship a dark theme with light native controls

Description: styles.css exposes every M3 role as a Tailwind utility for all apps that import it
Do: Use bg-surface text-on-surface bg-primary-container text-on-primary-container
Don't: Use palette utilities that ignore the theme

Description: Each theme maps --background --primary --card --border --ring onto the active M3 roles so shadcn-style classes follow the theme
Do: Use bg-background text-foreground bg-card border-border
Don't: Mix hard-coded white surfaces with themed text

Description: Brand colours (marine rose griffon brique) are theme-independent tokens shared by website and wiki
Do: Use bg-rg-marine text-rg-or bg-rg-brique
Don't: Write brand hex values in components

Guideline: Pair semantic states with their on-colour
Description: succes info and alerte have on-colours; alerte is light amber and needs dark text for 4.5:1
Do: Use bg-alerte text-on-alerte
Don't: Put text-white on bg-alerte

Description: Inazuma Eleven element and position colours are game constants defined once (element-feu vent foret montagne, poste-*)
Do: Use bg-element-vent or text-poste-gardien
Don't: Re-declare element colours in a component

Description: Discord Patreon Twitch YouTube and Instagram colours are fixed tokens that do not follow the theme
Do: Use bg-discord bg-twitch bg-patreon
Don't: Hard-code platform hex values

Description: tokens.ts is a pure generated projection with sRGB hex for Canvas, Discord bot rendering, scripts and tests because Skia cannot read oklch
Do: Import THEMES MARQUE and FORMES from @rosegriffon/ui/tokens
Don't: Parse styles.css or pass oklch strings to Canvas

Description: tokens.ts is generated from styles.css and must not be hand-edited
Do: Run bun packages/rg-ui/scripts/generer-tokens.ts after changing a theme
Don't: Edit tokens.ts by hand

Guideline: Use the M3 and fluid type classes
Description: rg-ui provides the 15 type-* M3 roles and clamp()-based text-fluid-* tokens for heroes and landing titles
Do: Use type-headline-medium or text-fluid-display-lg
Don't: Cascade sm: md: lg: font sizes on hero titles

Description: Base styles balance headings and use pretty wrapping for paragraphs and list items
Do: Inherit text-wrap balance and pretty
Don't: Force manual line breaks in headings

Description: rg-website loads Roboto (body) and Poppins (headings) with preload and Azalée fonts with preload false so the home page does not pay for them
Do: Declare fonts in lib/fonts.ts and expose CSS variables
Don't: Preload fonts used only by secondary sections
Code Good: export const notoSans = Noto_Sans({ preload: false, variable: "--font-noto-sans", subsets: ["latin"] })
Code Bad: export const notoSans = Noto_Sans({ subsets: ["latin"] }) // preloaded on every page

Description: Local app copies of UI components drift; the shared package is the single owner
Do: Import from @rosegriffon/ui or @rosegriffon/ui/<component>
Don't: Keep apps/<app>/src/components/ui copies

Guideline: Use asChild as a render adapter
Description: rg-ui components are Base UI primitives; asChild is adapted to the render prop and accepts exactly one element child
Do: Pass a single element child with asChild
Don't: Pass text or several children with asChild

Description: Every component sets data-slot so global styles target parts without new classes
Do: Style [data-slot=sidebar-container] when a global fix is needed
Don't: Rely on generated class order

Description: Components use focus-visible:ring-[3px] ring-ring/50 with outline-hidden; base styles add a rose outline and a forced-colors outline
Do: Reuse buttonVariants or the same focus classes
Don't: Use focus:outline-none without a replacement

Description: The destructive variant reads --destructive-foreground; a theme without it renders a label with no colour
Do: Declare --destructive-foreground in every theme and bridge it in @theme inline
Don't: Add a theme that omits --destructive-foreground

Description: ResponsiveDialog renders a dialog on desktop and a drawer on mobile with the same content
Do: Use ResponsiveDialog for forms opened from lists
Don't: Show a centred dialog on small phones

Description: @rosegriffon/app-shell provides AppSidebar WikiSidebar TopAppBar NavigationRail MobileBottomNav and Footer on top of the rg-ui Sidebar
Do: Compose the app chrome from app-shell inside SidebarProvider
Don't: Rebuild navigation chrome per app

Description: Sidebar widths are CSS variables (16rem expanded 18rem mobile 5rem rail); if w-(--sidebar-width) is not generated the gap stays 0 and the sidebar covers content
Do: Register rg-ui sources with @source or keep the data-slot width fallback
Don't: Ship without checking that sidebar-gap has a width

Guideline: Reuse the sidebar state and shortcut
Description: The sidebar persists its state in the sidebar_state cookie for seven days and toggles with Ctrl or Cmd+B
Do: Use useSidebar and toggleSidebar
Don't: Store a second sidebar flag in localStorage

Guideline: Expose navigation state to assistive tech
Description: Active links carry aria-current page, collapsible groups aria-expanded and icon toggles an aria-label
Do: Set aria-current on the active link and label icon-only toggles
Don't: Signal the active item by colour only

Guideline: Respect safe areas with the shared metrics
Description: Layouts declare viewportFit cover, so headers and bottom bars use pt-safe pb-safe and the HAUTEURS metrics
Do: Use pt-safe and pb-safe on fixed bars
Don't: Place fixed bars under the notch

Description: ThemeToggle shows a placeholder until mounted because the active theme is unknown during SSR
Do: Use ThemeToggle from app-shell or gate on mounted
Don't: Render the active theme name during SSR

Guideline: Keep focus visible in forced colors
Description: Component focus rings are box-shadows that disappear in high contrast; rg-ui replaces them with a CanvasText outline
Do: Keep the forced-colors outline rule when restyling focus
Don't: Remove outlines globally

Description: rg-ui only gates smooth scrolling; apps must gate their own animations
Do: Use motion-safe: and motion-reduce: variants or useReducedMotion
Don't: Run carousels and Ken Burns effects unconditionally

Description: Button Checkbox RadioGroup and Slider thumbs keep at least 44px targets
Do: Use size variants that keep the target
Don't: Shrink icon buttons below 44px on touch screens
